_readme: One entry per language of the app, keyed by its code in the string catalog (.lproj): en, fr, de, es-419, zh-Hans...
compose.py maps it to the Mac App Store code of the listing (de to de-DE, nb to no, es-419 to es-MX) for the folder name.
titles: the 5 titles of the Mac App Store screenshots 01 to 05, short and factual. No em dash or en dash.
demo: names the app does not translate because they are user data (GPU model, Bluetooth devices, disk names).
locale (optional): region used for dates and numbers, e.g. ar_AE; by default the usual country of the language.
